DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dil . ov. h 12344021 DILG OPINION No. NOV 09 2021 DIR. JOSEPHINE CABRIDO-LEYSA, CESO Ill Regional Director, Region XII Prime Regional Government Center Carpenter Hill, Koronadal City Dear Regional Director Cabrido-Leysa: This has reference to your letter dated October 12, 2021 requesting guidance on this issue: Whether or not the issuance by the President of the Certificate that an appeal was timely filed or an order from the Office of the President directing the submission of Appeal Memorandum and other records of the case, has the effect of automatically staying the execution of the order of imposing preventive suspension. As represented in your letter, the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Sultan Kudarat came up with a Resolution recommending to Govemor Suharto Mangudadatu the imposition of preventive suspension against elected Mayor Edwin Bermudez of Columbio, Sultan Kudarat. Governor Mangudadatu issued Administrative Order No. 43, series of 2021 placing Mayor Bermudez under preventive suspension for a period of 60 days. As represented by Governor Mangudadatu, the order was received by Mayor Bermudez on September 29, 2021. Immediately thereafter, elected Vice-Mayor Amirh Musali issued a Memorandum addressed to all Department Heads informing them that he will assume office citing Section 46 of the Local Government Code of 1991. Meanwhile, elected Mayor Bermudez filed with the Office of the President a Notice of Appeal on the order. Mayor Bermudez also sent a letter addressed to your good Office that with the filing of the appeal, the preventive suspension is deemed lifted as the jurisdiction over the case has been transferred to the Office of the President. Comes now the employees and personnel of Columbio seeking guidance from the Department on the matter. As an initial guidance, your good Office issued a letter dated September 6, 2021 stating that "xxx the preventive suspension against him [Mayor Bermudez] shall be deemed valid unless there is a contrary order or declaration by a court or appropriate tribunal". The counsel of Mayor Bermudez requested DILG-Region XII to retract their opinion for being constitutive of a "judgment" whilst the Appeal is pending with the Office of the President. Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

On October 12, 2021 , DILG-Region XII was furnished with a copy of the Order of the Office of the President in OP-DC Case No. 21-J-080 stating, among others: "To enable the Office to act on the appeal without necessarily giving due course thereto, it is hereby directed that: I. Within fifteen (15) days from receipt hereof, appellant Bermudez submit his Appeal Memorandum, copy furnished appellee Albert Astero, with proof of service submitted to this Office; 2. Within fifteen (15) days from receipt hereof, the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Sultan Kudarat forward to this Office certified true copies of the records with each page consecutively numbered and initialed by the custodia of the records together with a summary of proceedings thereon from the date of filing of the complaint up to its transmittal to this Office in chronological order indicating the action taken, incidents resolved, and listing of all pleadings, motions, manifestations, annexes, exhibits, and resolutions, and decisions as required under Memorandum Circular No. 123, Series of 1991. SO ORDERED." Hence, your query. It may be recalled that in the Memorandum dated January 23, 2021 re AMENDMENT TO THE MEMORANDUM RE APPEAL TO THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT FROM DECISION/RESOLUTION/ORDER OF SANGGUNIANG PANLALAWIGAN AND/OR SANGGUNIANG PANLUNGSOD, it was stated that: "A reading of Section 9 above would suggests that the filing of the Notice of Appeal stays execution, if the same was filed within the prescribed period. However, to determine timeliness, an expressed declaration from the Office of the President to that effect is a condition sine qua non. Thus, after seeking guidance from the Office of the President (OP), the Department was advised to require the party claiming a timely appeal to obtain a certification from the OP to be signed by the Deputy Executive Secretary for Legal Affairs (DESLA) or under his authority by stating that such appeal was filed within the prescribed period. Said certification should be submitted to the Department. This is without prejudice to OP'S issuance of a contrary Order." Based on the foregoing, there are two (2) ways in which the Decision/Resolution/Order of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan or Panlungsod may be stayed, namely: I) If the party can show that he has timely filed a Notice of Appeal to the Office of the President by obtaining a Certification to this effect from the DESLA and submitting it to the Department; or 2) The Office of the President issues a contrary order or order staying the execution of the Decision/ResoIution/Order of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan or Panlungsod. Page 2 of 3

Upon evaluation of the documents submitted to the Central Office, it seems that none of the above-enumerated ways were complied with in the case at hand. The aforequoted Order of the Office of the President in OP-DC Case No. 21-J-080 is obviously not the Certification that is being required/contemplated in the aforesaid DILG Memorandum, albeit it came from DESLA. Neither could it be considered as a substantial compliance thereof because the OP Order does not contain a statement that a Notice of Appeal was timely filed before the Office of the President. The aforesaid OP Order cannot also be considered a stay order since it does not contain a statement which declares that the Administrative Order No. 043 dated September 27 2021 of Governor Mangudadatu placing elected Mayor Bermudez under preventive suspension, is stayed during the pendency of his appeal to OP. In fact, said Order clearly states that the OP has yet to give due course thereto. For this, this level is of the view that unless and until any of the 2 ways mentioned above is complied with by elected Mayor Bermudez, his preventive suspension should continue. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities, the courts and or a contrary issuance from the Office of the President. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, THORITY OF THE SECRETARY: t' DILG MA GAN e reta or Local Govemment OUSLG/MLVLLLS-LRALLD/clp Page 3 of 3
